title: Hearing on Fiscal Year 2027 executive budget for city agencies
summary: The Council holds a hearing on Mayor's Fiscal Year 2027 executive budget covering the Human Resources Administration, Department of Social Services, Department of Homeless Services, Department of Sanitation and the Conflicts of Interest Board. The session runs from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. and is held jointly with the Committees on General Welfare, Sanitation and Solid Waste Management, and Governmental Operations, State & Federal Legislation.
